description: Defines the CordRepCrc structure and related functions for handling CRC nodes in a cord tree, including functions to remove and skip CRC nodes, and accessors for CRC data.

classes.name: CordRepCrc
classes.description: A specialized CordRep node that associates an expected CRC with contained data, used at the top level of a cord tree.

methods.name: CordRepCrc::New
methods.description: Creates a new CordRepCrc node with a given child and CRC state.
